CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_FinancialProductApplication_DEP
AS
BEGIN
WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication AS
(
	SELECT
		BDG.SCHM_CODE AS FinancialProductId
		,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,BDG.LCHG_TIME AS Timestamp
		,BDG.SCHM_TYPE AS FcbsApplicationId
		,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BDG.insert_dttm AS InsertDttm
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE_DELTA BDGD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENSCHMPARMTABLE BDG
		ON BDGD.SCHM_CODE = BDG.SCHM_CODE
        AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,Timestamp ,FcbsApplicationId)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId ,Timestamp ,FcbsApplicationId)) AS HASHROW
		,FinancialProductId ,FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
),

TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA AS
(
		SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialProductId,TGT.FinancialProductId) AS FinancialProductId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
		AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
	FinancialProductId = SRC.FinancialProductId
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp = SRC.Timestamp
	,FcbsApplicationId = SRC.FcbsApplicationId
	,SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId = SRC.TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId = SRC.WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication TGT
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA DELTA
	ON DELTA.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
	AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication SRC
	ON SRC.FinancialProductId = TGT.FinancialProductId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId

INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProductApplication
	(FinancialProductId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,FcbsApplicationId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	FinancialProductId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,Timestamp
	,FcbsApplicationId
	,SourceSystemCode
	,TaskRunId
	,WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_FinancialProductApplication_DELTA;

END
